summary: Dataset windows show the loading animation immediately and temporary views open faster.
details: The Loading Dataset popup now appears as soon as a dataset window opens, instead of a blank "No dataset loaded" page while the data loads.
Temporary-view windows skip the redundant dropdown, preference, and sidecar boot loads, removing a multi-second blank delay on network-drive installs.
Dataset Type and reserving-class lists load concurrently during window boot and run validation.
